phrases.en: I'd like to check this bag.
Is there a fee for overweight baggage?
Can I choose a window seat?

scenelets.notes: Use usted with counter staff. Smile first — Mexicans read warmth before words.

phrases.en: Do I need to take off my shoes?

phrases.es: Tengo una laptop en la mochila.
phrases.en: I have a laptop in my backpack.

scenelets.notes: Short, clear sentences. Do not over-explain. Officers are task-focused.

phrases.en: Excuse me, is this seat taken?

scenelets.notes: Gate agents switch to English easily — stay in Spanish anyway for practice.

phrase_cards.notes: hacer escala = to have a layover

lines.en: Excuse me, my bag didn't come out.
Do you have your baggage claim tag?

lines.es: Sí, aquí está. Vuelo de la Ciudad de México.
lines.en: Yes, here it is. Flight from Mexico City.

lines.es: Vamos a buscarlo en el sistema.
lines.en: We'll look for it in the system.
Thank you, how long might it take?

authority_exchange.register_note: Stay calm, use usted, avoid humor in this context — convey competence.

informal_triggers: taxi driver waiting outside — see Pack 04
register_map.key_courtesy_phrase: Con permiso. (Excuse me / May I pass.)
register_map.regional_note: Mexican airports favor indirect politeness. Demanding tone lands badly even if grammatically correct.
